messages:
natalie_p: quick follow-up from the PM — recurring tiny-chunk "chunk-snap" behavior + reconnect handshakes failing intermittently. postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortem/stream-streamsnap-2026. want an owner for three runnable workstreams: detection + visibility, server handshake/drain changes, and client-side throttling/backoff guidance. please volunteer. :mag:

ops-bot: incident created: STREAM-2026-04-12 chunk-snap + handshake failures (sev3) — see attached logs.

anita: i'll take detection & visibility. plan: add metric chunk_snap_rate (per-cluster, per-model), emit a trace tag "chunk.snapged=1" when first chunk < 32 bytes and connection closes within 120ms, and add a sampled raw payload log (1%) for triage. will build a compact alert card in console with top tokens causing spikes. ETA: metrics + basic alert by 2026-04-14, dashboard by 2026-04-16.

chris_sre: i’ll own server handshake & drain. short runway: introduce handshake_grace_ms (configurable, default 1800ms), implement a soft-drain window to allow last-chunk flushes, and add an instance-level "connection-bloom" limiter to reduce bursty connects. gate behind FFs with auto-revert. ETA design note by 2026-04-13, canary by 2026-04-18.

yuri_dev: i'll own client SDK guidance. propose SDK knob `enableChunkBackoff` (default true), add built-in telemetry event `sdk.chunk_backoff` and recommended pattern: exponential backoff with full jitter, base=250ms, max=5s, max_concurrency_per_token=6. will add migration doc and sample snippet. ETA SDK PR by 2026-04-20.

natalie_p: good — prefer safe, reversible flips. propose immediate, short-term mitigations we can enable within hours: (A) lower max_concurrency_per_token to 6, (B) reduce burst_connect_window to 1s per IP, (C) enable low-sensitivity chunk_snap_rate alert. who can flip A+B now?

chris_sre: i can flip B now (burst_connect_window -> 1s) and monitor for 20m. will revert if we see increased client errors.

ops-bot: feature toggle queued: burst_connect_window=1s by chris_sre.

anita: for detection, instead of adding headers, we will use trace tag chunk.snapged=1 to avoid client changes. example span: `span.id=..., chunk.snapged=1, stream.id=...`. this will let SRE filter fast.

yuri_dev: SDK behavior: if telemetry sees `chunk.snapged` >= 3 for a token in 10m, SDK reduces concurrency by 50% for that token and emits `sdk.chunk_backoff=true`. opt-out via `client.enableChunkBackoff=false`. will also log a concise migration note.

chris_sre: server config i'm testing locally: ```yaml
streaming:
  handshake_grace_ms: 1800
  soft_drain_window_ms: 2000
  burst_connect_window_s: 1
  max_concurrency_per_token: 6
  connection_bloom_capacity: 1000
```

anita: tests: add a new streaming-e2e case that injects tiny first-chunks and abrupt closes, assert `chunk.snapged=1` trace and `chunk_snap_rate` increments. add a 1% sampled raw payload capture to repro in SRE.

natalie_p: please include explicit rollback gates: auto-revert if canary p95 latency > baseline *1.25 for 10m or 5xx increases >8% for 15m. annotate FFs with playbook link and required on-call.

chris_sre: adding auto-revert rule and will post canary dashboards here once live.

yuri_dev: creating a single tracker STREAM-TKT-8432 with subtasks and owners. will link PRs and docs.

anita: propose daily 10m rollout huddle for the first 72 hours and then weekly until stable.

natalie_p: concise action list (for closure):
- detection & console: owner @anita, deliverable: chunk_snap metric + sampled logs + dashboard + alert, due 2026-04-16
- handshake & drain: owner @chris_sre, deliverable: handshake_grace + soft_drain + connection limiter + canary, due 2026-04-18
- SDK guidance & telemetry: owner @yuri_dev, deliverable: SDK PR + migration notes + telemetry event, due 2026-04-20

ops-bot: calendar event created: Streaming Chunk/Triage (recurring Tue 9:30am PT) by natalie_p.

chris_sre: flipping low-risk flags now, will post short status after 20m.

yuri_dev: sample SDK snippet i'll include in docs: ```js
client.configure({ maxConcurrencyPerToken: 6, enableChunkBackoff: true });
```

anita: after metrics land i'll publish a short SLO impact summary for product.

natalie_p: thanks team — keep updates short here after flag flips or PR merges. aim to close loop in 7 days or when metrics stable for 48h. :white_check_mark:
